summary: The admitted hidden giant eel recording reached read.c:create_particular_creation's hidden-eel-in-pool condition, where JavaScript called is_pool without importing it. Importing the existing dbridge.js predicate restores the source branch; the full recording now matches.

source.branch: Upstream read.c:create_particular_creation (3252-3371) sets mtmp->mundetected when d->hidden and the monster is a hider, hides under an object, or is an eel on a pool square. The eel condition is evaluated after makemon returns the actual location.
source.javascript: js/read.js:create_particular_creation mirrors this clause with mtmp.data.mlet === S_EEL && is_pool(mx, my, state). read.js now imports is_pool from js/dbridge.js, which already exports the source implementation.
callers: wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis -> read.c:create_particular -> read.c:create_particular_creation; js/wizcmds.js:wiz_genesis -> js/read.js:create_particular -> js/read.js:create_particular_creation
dependencies: dbridge.c:is_pool is already implemented in js/dbridge.js; only the named import is missing.
source.resolution: Import is_pool from js/dbridge.js without changing the source branch, hidden-state conditions, or call order.

evidence: The admitted v70 evaluation reports 0/268 screens matched and a ReferenceError: is_pool is not defined. The focused scan reproduced the stop at js/read.js:3606 while creating the requested hidden giant eel after #wizgenesis.

The v70 manifest records the C target: actual pool wish, adjacent giant eel, then reveal-hidden-monster. The failing input boundary is the newline completing the hidden giant eel request at segment 0 step 216.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:create_particular_creation (3252-3371) checks d->hidden and sets mundetected for an eel only when is_pool(mx, my) is true. js/dbridge.js exports is_pool; js/read.js imports and uses it in the corresponding branch.
After adding the import, the focused bounded scan emitted and matched all 268/268 screens, RNG calls, cursors, and the input boundary through segment 0 step 267. No unported callees were reached.
